paragraphs: Margaret is retired and confirmed that her circumstances and objectives remain unchanged since her previous review. She remains comfortable with the agreed moderate approach to risk and is satisfied with the portfolio’s performance. She has cash on deposit in her Holloway cash account and would like to use this year’s ISA allowance by moving some of it into her Stocks & Shares ISA. She has no current income requirement from the portfolio and does not expect this to change in the near term.
